verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's virtual key system explicitly supports per-key budgets (budget_duration, max_budget), rate limits (rpm_limit), and personal/team-scoped keys, directly enabling an autonomous agent to get its own key with spend and rate guardrails. Docs also show spend tracking by key/user/tag to monitor and enforce these limits. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that budget caps hard-stop overspend in practice, and more detail on rate-limit enforcement behavior under load.
